note: The home planet: the hand-built port town on the sand. town names an authored town instead of a generated one, laid out by town_layout (issue #237: a saved layout in content/core/towns/, at its town_size), and world an authored world (content/core/worlds/), so nothing about the port changes. See docs/planets/PLANETS.md.

natives.note: Issue #96: the dune people in one friendly and one hostile pack, and sand pigs. Each pack has a camp (where it starts, a stop after route point 'stop_after', and where it sleeps). Routes and camps are map points (metres along the ground from the port).

barge.note: Issue #269: this planet's party barge (content/core/barges/party_barge.json has the numbers every barge shares; any of them can be set here). name is the barge's, boss.name its owner's; home is a map point (metres along the ground from the port).
barge.name: the Gilded Wallow

beast.note: The home planet's beast (content/core/hazards/beast.json has the numbers every beast shares; any of them can be set here too). name is what the locals call it; home is a map point (metres along the ground from the port); lore is what the locals say of it, in passing and to anyone who asks.
beast.name: Old Murk
lore: Stay off the far flats. Old Murk crawls out there.
Old Murk took a whole caravan once. Walked right over it on all those legs.
If you hear something like a wet raspberry out in the sand, run.
Don't shoot at Old Murk. It remembers, and it follows.
Nobody's ever killed Old Murk. Plenty have tried. You can tell by the smell.
Old Murk doesn't hunt. It just goes where it likes, clicking those jaws, and you'd best not be there.
lore_slain: They say someone killed Old Murk. I'll believe it when I smell it gone.
Old Murk's dead, they're saying. The far flats feel wrong without it.
